skill.name: wp-orchestrator
skill.description: Coordinates WordPress project discovery, local setup, audits, quality checks, packaging, deployment, and client handoff using related WordPress skills.
skill.summary: Orchestrates complete WordPress build, audit, launch, and handoff workflows.
skill.author: CrazySwami

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown tables, code fences, installation paths, and placeholder URLs. Confirmed issues are limited to production-risk examples: CDN-hosted frontend scripts and a WordPress database dump staged through temporary storage. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration intent, or malicious persistence instructions were found.

remediation.issue: CDN-hosted frontend scripts appear in theme code examples.
remediation.suggestion: Use locally built assets for production, or pin exact versions and add integrity controls where the platform supports them.

remediation.issue: The production sync workflow exports a WordPress database dump through a temporary path.
remediation.suggestion: Export database files to a restricted directory, remove them after import, and document backup and access-control requirements.

remediation.issue: Installation and workflow examples rely on absolute /root/.claude paths.
remediation.suggestion: Use portable placeholders and ask users to confirm skill locations before running helper scripts.

remediation.issue: The optional WP-CLI download example does not include verification steps.
remediation.suggestion: Add checksum or signature verification guidance before making downloaded PHAR files executable.

content.value_statement: WordPress projects require coordinated setup, audits, deployment, and client handoff. This skill organizes those workflows across specialized WordPress tools.
actual_capabilities: Runs a structured discovery interview for new WordPress projects.
Detects Docker, WordPress Playground, and standard WordPress environments.
Coordinates SEO, visual QA, performance, and security review workflows.
Creates phased todo lists for setup, content, testing, and launch work.
Guides theme packaging, GitHub deployment, WP Pusher updates, and client handoff.
limitations: Requires related WordPress skills and helper scripts for many audit steps.
Assumes Docker, WP-CLI, Git, and optional GitHub CLI are available when used.
Uses example paths and URLs that must be adapted for each project.
Does not replace human review before production deployment.

use_cases.title: Plan a New WordPress Build
use_cases.description: Collect requirements, define pages, choose environment setup, and create a phased implementation checklist.

use_cases.title: Audit an Existing Site
use_cases.description: Coordinate SEO, visual QA, performance, and security checks into one prioritized report.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Launch
use_cases.description: Review launch readiness, package the theme, verify handoff documentation, and organize client training tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Start Project Discovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use wp-orchestrator to interview me for a new WordPress site. Build a phased todo list from my answers.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My WordPress Site
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use wp-orchestrator to audit my WordPress site for SEO, visual QA, performance, security, and launch blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Create Launch Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use wp-orchestrator to create a launch checklist for this WordPress project, including testing, packaging, deployment, and handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Full Delivery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow across build, deployment, and handoff.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use wp-orchestrator to coordinate a full WordPress delivery plan from discovery through GitHub deployment, WP Pusher updates, and client documentation.

output_examples.input: Set up a new WordPress site for a local service business.
output: Discovery questions covering goals, pages, brand, SEO, and handoff needs.
A phased checklist for Docker setup, theme scaffold, plugin setup, content, QA, and launch.
Recommended next skills for Docker, SEO, visual testing, and white-labeling.

output_examples.input: Audit this existing WordPress site before launch.
output: A combined audit plan for SEO, screenshots, performance checks, plugin review, and security settings.
Prioritized findings grouped by launch impact.
A concise action plan with owners and suggested order of work.

output_examples.input: Prepare this theme for production and client handoff.
output: Theme packaging steps with excluded development files.
Deployment options using GitHub, WP Pusher, or file sync.
Client documentation topics for login, page editing, media, SEO, and support.

best_practices: Confirm the WordPress environment and backup status before running setup or sync commands.
Use staging URLs and test data until the client approves production changes.
Review generated todo lists with the project owner before assigning automated tasks.
anti_patterns: Running database sync or deployment commands against production without a current backup.
Copying example URLs, paths, or credentials into a real project without editing them.
Skipping manual review of plugin choices, security settings, and generated launch reports.
